text_block_list.text:
I managed to get my weight back in time 
for the Yushun Himba (Oaks)! But... I 
couldn't do the ideal training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm nervous, but you told me to run with 
no regrets, Trainer...! I'll give it 
everything I've got out there!
